# Baldi London Marina Mall

> Baldi London is a footwear and accessories brand with a boutique on the first floor of Dubai Marina Mall. The waterfront mall holds around 140 shops and more than twenty cafes and restaurants across four levels, together with a children's play area, and connects to a five-star hotel and the marina promenade. It serves the surrounding cluster of residential towers as well as visitors to the marina.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Dubai Marina, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Baldi London is a British fashion footwear and accessories brand with a store on the first floor of Dubai Marina Mall. MENASCO carried out the electromechanical works for the shop fit-out on behalf of BravaCasa Interior Design. The installation was coordinated with the mall's base-building services and the landlord's fit-out requirements.
